title: Owen et al. (2008): Recrystallize ODPA reagent

intuition.title: Study context: A measured core and qualified later treatments
intuition.text: One seven-minute CdSe core preparation has an approximately 4 nm product. ZnS shell growth and later ligand treatments are source-described supporting processes; missing seed amount, shell dimensions and specimen-specific exchange charges remain visible.
intuition.source_locator: SI PDF p. 4–6, CdSe synthesis and cleaning; SI PDF p. 5–7, Shell growth and exchange

intuition.title: Study context: Surface bonding is a spectroscopic model
intuition.text: NMR, released molecular products and XPS support anionic X-type ligand binding to a Cd-rich surface. The authors distinguish this model from a universally proven nanocrystal surface structure; no atomic coordinates, crystal polymorph or surface site map are provided.

intuition.title: Study context: Adsorption and substitution differ
intuition.text: Unprotected thiols bind while retaining phosphonate; added triethylamine promotes displacement. Protected thiol and chloride reagents cleave phosphonate directly. Spectral changes and colloidal behavior are not additional particle-size measurements.
intuition.source_locator: Main PDF p. 2, Schemes 2–3 and thiol experiments

bindings.caption: Heat/stir 100 g ODPA in 150 mL ethanol until clear; numerical temperature unreported. Equipment geometry is illustrative; exact source conditions are retained in the operation.

Slowly add hexane to 1 L total volume, stand overnight on the bench, refrigerate for 6 h, then filter. Refrigerator temperature and exact overnight duration are unreported. Equipment geometry is illustrative; exact source conditions are retained in the operation.

Heat the filtered solid with stirring at 100 °C under vacuum to remove trapped ethanol; time and pressure unreported. Equipment geometry is illustrative; exact source conditions are retained in the operation.

Slowly add 300 mL toluene while stirring, remove heat, cool the white suspension to room temperature and filter. Equipment geometry is illustrative; exact source conditions are retained in the operation.

Dry under dynamic vacuum for 24 h; recover approximately 75 g. No drying temperature or pressure is supplied. Equipment geometry is illustrative; exact source conditions are retained in the operation.

general_background.title: Destabilizing a particle dispersion
general_background.summary: An antisolvent can solvate a particle's ligand shell less favourably than the original dispersion medium. Reduced solvation can weaken colloidal stability and allow particles to aggregate and separate from the liquid, depending on the ligands and solvent mixture.
general_background.label: General background, not the authors' interpretation
